parts.label: (b)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: M1*: Correct method for a vector equation of $AC$ or $BD$. A1FT: Both diagonal equations correct, following their $D$; condone missing $\mathbf r=$. DM1: Equate at least two corresponding components and solve for one parameter using different parameters. A1: $\lambda=-1/4$ or $\mu=1/4$ (depending on directions). A1: $\overrightarrow{OP}=\frac34\mathbf i+\frac14\mathbf j-\frac74\mathbf k$; coordinates accepted, do not ignore subsequent work. Printed similar-triangle alternative accepted. Total 5.
